YouTube Analytics day boundaries use Pacific Time. Recent Analytics data can lag processing, so the interactive default end date is three days ago; a different end date can still be entered manually.
-views is defined as sort order using field parameters.sorts, but -views is not selected in 'metrics' or 'dimensions' parameters.
